purpose: Teach: 美奈子/貞子/アヤ/マサ/わらしべ/ガンモ/キチン/逸品

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の美奈子さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer—the one with her friend Minako—she was telling me about their tea time together.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Soft, almost conversational. Speaking from genuine noticing, not reporting. Slight fondness at the edges. Unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お孫様のお名前が貞子ちゃんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Her grandson's name is Sadako, apparently. She mentioned it when she was in yesterday.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Small smile in the voice—the pleasure of learning something intimate about a regular. Settled, almost thinking-out-loud quality.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ペットの名前をアヤちゃんって付けたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She named her pet Aya. I thought that was really sweet when she told me.
lines.style: Soft warmth with a thread of genuine affection. Slight lift at 'Aya'—the discovery of something small and kind. Trailing off gently, like she's still sitting with the thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お友達のマサさんとよく来店されるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She comes in regularly with her friend Masa. They've become a bit of a fixture here.
lines.style: Observant, matter-of-fact but tinged with genuine fondness. The tone of someone who notices patterns and loves them for it. Steady, grounded delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、わらしべ長者の昔話の現代版小説を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was reading this modern retelling of the Warashibe Chooja tale—you know, the old folk story.
lines.style: Curious, slightly animated. Speaking with the pleasure of discovering what someone reads. A bit of gentle wonder—the kind of book choice that tells you something about a person.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、和食のガンモ、つまりがんもどきの煮物がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She loves ganmodoki—those fried tofu cakes—braised the traditional way.
lines.style: Knowledgeable but not pedantic. Warm recognition of shared taste. The cadence of someone who remembers what matters to the people they serve. Genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エビ殻のキチン由来の化粧品を愛用されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She uses cosmetics made from shrimp shell chitin. Mentioned it was her favourite skincare line.
lines.style: Interested, careful precision in the details. Not clinical—genuinely engaged by the specificity of what someone values. Slight warmth underscoring the attention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、京都の逸品菓子の話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was telling me about these beautiful hand-made sweets from Kyoto. You could tell she loved talking about them.
lines.style: Warm, gentle listener's tone. The pleasure of someone who enjoys hearing others speak about what moves them. Soft close, trailing slightly—still hearing her voice.
